summary:
complete — read-only audit, no builds/profiling. Branch not verified (`git rev-parse` needs shell, out of scope); paths below are `noteapp/` = `bref/` code.

1. What already keeps keystrokes fast:
- Editor `views/editor/layout.rs:plan/reuse/BigBlock` redoes only damaged lines, shifts rest; `>1500`-row tables shape cells near screen; checked by `shell/tests/layout.rs:layout_reuse_matches_full_layout`.
- Vault index off UI: `shell/library.rs:228-232,131-134` + watcher loop `80-140` (`250ms` burst, `fingerprint`+`rescan_full(known)` on `background_executor`, adaptive `took*200` pause).
- Palette/search in memory, lowered once: `logic/note.rs:19-31`, vault search `shell/search.rs:~178-193` sorts+`markdown::hits` on background.
- Figures/SVG off UI: `views/editor/paint.rs:5-Job/load/drawn` (one/family, old stays), `views/viewer.rs:Load/Tile (TILE:512,KEPT:64,FLYING:8)`, caps `ui/svg.rs:MAX_SIDE:8192,MAX_PIXELS:16M`, fonts `LazyLock`.
- CSV/grid on-demand: `logic/table.rs`, `views/sheet/disk.rs:155-` save on background; PDF `shell/print.rs:35-`, sync fetch/push `shell/sync.rs:29-`, backup/drops/capture/export_png similar `background_executor`.

2. Where UI still blocks:
- Startup sync read before first frame (ARCH `How main parts work:Startup`); large-note + system-font DB warm on first SVG can jank.
- Saves sync on UI: `shell/notes.rs:388-flush_one` (`ponytail` comment) `vault::save` + `markdown::index` + `flush:349-` loops all panes + `refresh_embeds`; rename rewrites links vault-wide.
- Large docs: 1400-row formula table ~25ms/key (`book/src/performance.md`); many `![[embeds]]` (`views/editor/embed.rs`) relayout on every flush.
- Images: `views/viewer.rs:Source::Raster` drawn whole by GPU (not tiled); huge `Source::File` parse cost.
- Git: merge on UI `shell/sync.rs:42-50` (`ponytail: frozen few tenths`); CSV open sync `views/sheet/disk.rs:34-load` (`ponytail:100MB~0.3s`).
- Index churn: `library.rs:127 notes.clone()` per check, `push_names_to:286-` rebuilds `Rc` name/alias/source maps for tabs on every `sync`.

3. Improvements (value order), all `files:line`:
1. Async `flush_one` (`shell/notes.rs:391`): snapshot text+`save_gen`, `background_executor vault::save+index`, apply if generation+`!dirty` (pattern at `notes.rs:501-505`, `sheet/disk.rs:160-`).
2. Extend incremental layout: cache embed/formula/grid `results` by version; avoid full `refresh_embeds`; keep `BigBlock/check` for wide-table header edits (`layout.rs`).
3. Debounce/coalesce watcher: keep `250ms`+`fingerprint` gate, skip `rescan_full` while `save_gen/dirty` changes (already `applied` retry `library.rs:135-`); incremental per-file index update, versioned `push_names`/tree/palette invalidation.
4. Warm caches off UI at startup: last-note read, `svg::fonts()`, icon set, `saved_format`, vault `fingerprint` before first frame; lazy `viewer` tiles prefetch neighbors.
5. Move rest off UI: `sheet/disk.rs:34 load` with loading state, git merge chunk (`sync.rs:42-`), tree rebuild diff (`views/nav.rs,shell/sidebar.rs`), cap `Raster` with tiled/downscaled path.
Open: target vault/note/table sizes? Which jank matters most: startup, save, palette, graph, PDF?
